info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Weather Alerts Radars-v4-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Radar API provides users with access to real-time weather alerts and radar information. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve current radar data related to severe weather warnings and alerts in specified regions. It is particularly useful for applications that require timely weather updates, such as safety monitoring systems, disaster response applications, or weather reporting services. Developers can integrate this information to enhance user experience and provide critical weather data efficiently.

get.description: This API endpoint allows users to fetch radar alerts, providing important information related to alerts detected in real-time. Utilize this endpoint to stay updated with the latest alert data.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the parameters necessary to filter and retrieve radar alerts. Ensure that the request adheres to the required schema for accurate response.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested radar alerts.
